svg.title: Classification accuracy
svg.desc: Layer I: published 76.89%, reconstruction 76.21%. Layer II: published 61.93%, reconstruction 60.98%. Published: leave-one-out validation. Reconstruction: mean of five grouped outer folds. Layer II evaluates known enhancers.
